phase: E2 — fixed-base actuator and added-load sensitivity
geometry: Unchanged registered SUPER airframe, Qingyu 0.28 m single section (0.25 kg), 0.20 kg distal assembly; fixed airframe, E1 validated phi=180 degrees, gravity -9.81 m/s^2. Reuse E1 command and nominal model.
bounds_source: Prescribed engineering perturbations for sensitivity, not measured uncertainty limits, rated payloads, or hardware register settings. Passive joint damping and torque limit are fixed.
load_model: Rigid equivalent ballast with COM at the native gripper TCP. Solid sphere inertia (2/5 mr^2; r=15 mm) in the tool frame, implemented by mass, COM and inertia addition. No geometry/contact object is added. Independently verify added mass, added first moment, and full inertia by a parallel-axis sum.
design: All 27 deterministic factor combinations at N=8, dt=0.5 ms, 14 s each. No stochastic repeats. No physical actuation. Base trace must reproduce E1 within 0.001 mm TCP and 0.0001 deg bend. Same open-loop command, closed joint servos. All cases retained.
motion: E1 raised cosine: neutral 0–1 s, 0–90 deg 1–5 s, 90–118 deg 5–7 s, hold 118 deg 7–9 s, return to 0 by 13 s, settle to 14 s. Same discrete left-endpoint command at each physics step.
signals: Every 5 ms save commanded and net bend, total curvature, TCP and backbone end in world metres. Retain integrated qpos, qvel, applied ctrl at 20 ms and initial/final states for replay. Count all native contacts, torque saturation, >120 deg, nonfinite and solver warnings at physics-step rate; preserve extrema and event witnesses. Keep all cases incl. failures.
metrics: Hold deficit 118 minus mean net bend over [8.5,9.0] s. Rise and fall delay: linearly interpolated 59-degree crossing vs command. Positive hold overshoot=max(max_bend_in_hold-118,0). Compare peak 3D TCP difference at aligned times to nominal. Also report signed paired results: identical two other factors for low-to-high contrasts; corner difference-in-differences of stiffness and load at nominal damping. No inference across machines or general parameter importance.
interpretation: Use predeclared E1 numerical budgets at the selected perturbed cells. An excursion or failed check limits the scope of the associated comparison. Do not retune thresholds. Physical identification needs a known load, registered TCP or independent shape observation, timing and held-out trials. Default manuscript stays at its reviewed E1 state; deliver separate E2 candidate for review.
